east_catalysts_risks.notes: Only the Blue Line trial-run items fall inside the window (published 10 Nov 2026). Searches on PRR/Business Corridor, STRR/Hoskote, Sarjapur-Hebbal metro, K-RIDE, Cauvery Stage V, lake flooding and office leasing returned no 8-11 Nov items I could verify; search-snippet items (e.g. K-RIDE Corridor 4 Rs 342 crore award around 29 Oct, Savills/JLL Q3 leasing, Deccan Herald Phase 3A April 2033 and STRR girder pieces) were pre-window and not fetched or quote-verified (Deccan Herald returned 403), so they are omitted. Site-targeted searches on specific outlets and BMRCL were not run.

east_launches_prices.notes: No confirmed new East Bengaluru residential launch or new phase published inside the 8–11 Nov 2026 window was found. Searches surfaced only aggregator pages and older news. Two lead items (Swarajya, The Bengaluru Live) are about the Blue Line trial: Swarajya (10 Nov) was fetched and confirms the 15 November target and charging from 30 October; The Bengaluru Live article was not located, so Urban Acres (10 Nov) is cited for the 10 November run to Doddanekkundi. Urban Acres is a trade site, so a stronger outlet should confirm. Items not reported for lack of verbatim page evidence: Sumadhura Solace (Whitefield) with 777 homes, 7 towers and booking on 14 November, which appeared only in a search summary; Mana Verdant Terraces (Varthur, Sept 2026); Puravankara Balagere. RERA portal and developer sites were not checked. The two project records are pre-window background from PropNewz, a portal blog and interested source.

north_south_west.notes: No residential launches (villa, plotted or apartment) dated 8-11 Nov 2026 were found in North, South or West Bengaluru. Searches only returned older launches (e.g. Sumadhura Panorama Phase II, Devanahalli, June 2026; Bhartiya Nikoo Homes 8, Thanisandra, June 2026), which are outside the window and are not reported as claims. thehindu.com, hindustantimes.com and deccanherald.com could not be fetched (blocked or 403), so the Hindu, HT and DH leads are unconfirmed beyond search snippets. DH snippets say the BDA stated the Hebbal flyover and Ballari Road would not be fully closed for 18 months, with two lanes and the service road staying open. They also say the CM's figure for the combined short tunnel and elevated corridor is Rs 2,110 crore, against Rs 2,215 crore elsewhere. I could not quote either from the page, so neither is reported as a claim. The Vijayanagar Purple Line incident and the airport local-hiring story could not be found in any reachable source. Trade Brains is a weak SEO source and its price ranges were not quoted. No Kanakapura, Bidadi, Hoskote, Doddaballapur or Mysore Road launch news was found in the window.
